counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of invasive growth or metastasis
No mention of high-grade cytologic atypia
decisive_items: Papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores that are lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium
Shows mucin-containing goblet cells. Neither cytologic atypia nor atypical mitotic figures are present
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it has the most specific and detailed histologic findings that match the diagnosis of inverted papilloma, including papillary fronds with nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium and mucin-containing goblet cells. R3 is the runner-up because it also has some matching histologic findings, but they are less specific and do not include the characteristic mucin-containing goblet cells.

rejected.why: R4 is rejected because the lack of cytologic atypia or atypical mitotic figures makes verrucous carcinoma less likely.
C1 is rejected because it is an append-only completion and does not have enough specific histologic findings to support the diagnosis of squamous cell papilloma of the nasal vestibule.
